identity.title: [v0.92][runtime][shepherd] Pull local Gemma/MLX Shepherd MVP forward

values.task_boundary: Implement a local Apple Metal/MLX Shepherd adapter behind explicit config and governed Runtime v3 admission, expose truthful response/status evidence to the separate Observatory, and prove real invocation plus unavailable, timeout, malformed, and unauthorized failures.
deliverables: Explicitly configured bounded local MLX/Gemma adapter with timeout, cancellation, output limits, and redacted metadata
Signed/capability-governed Runtime command route and correlated response envelope
Observatory control/status integration that distinguishes real, fake, retained, and unavailable evidence
Deterministic adapter negatives plus one real local-model smoke and browser round-trip proof
acceptance_criteria: An explicitly configured local MLX/Gemma adapter executes a real bounded Shepherd request when available
The Observatory sends the request through authenticated/signed governed Runtime v3 ingress and displays the correlated result
Runtime and Observatory distinguish unavailable, deterministic-test, retained, and real-local-model states
Missing model, timeout, cancellation, malformed or oversized input, and unsigned/unauthorized mutation fail truthfully without taking down Runtime
Deterministic tests cover adapter/admission/status behavior and cannot satisfy the real-model criterion
A real macOS Apple Metal/MLX smoke retains model identity, correlation, timing, and response evidence under redaction policy
No AWS, hosted inference, cloud fallback, global default switch, or v0.95 completion claim occurs
One exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings
dependencies: WP-03 issue 5820 stable Guardian/Runtime launch and readiness
WP-14 issue 5832 stable command and WSS contracts before final integration
Configured local Apple Metal/MLX runtime and model for the real smoke lane
non_goals: Full v0.95 Shepherd/Gemma training, Aptitude Atlas, or evaluator program
AWS, hosted inference, cloud fallback, or provider billing work
Global default model switch or broad intelligence/safety claims
Runtime launch or ACIP/A2A contract redesign
Observatory visual redesign or Unity integration
